t: You're looking at St Mary Abchurch, a Church of England church just off Cannon Street. Dedicated to the Blessed Virgin Mary, it's first mentioned in 1198 to 1199. The medieval church was destroyed in the Great Fire of London in 1666, and the building in front of you replaced it. Christopher Wren designed it, one of fifty-two City churches he was given to rebuild after the fire. Anthony Abdy, a merchant and alderman of London who lived from 1579 to 1640, is buried here.
